BioSynth_SlavesOfHorax.PsychicRitualDef_.label: draw shamblers
BioSynth_SlavesOfHorax.PsychicRitualDef_.description: Create a psychic pulse which will draw a distant horde of animated corpses towards your local area. They attack any humans that they see, save for their dark masters.
BioSynth_SlavesOfHorax.PsychicRitualDef_.outcomeDescription: The higher the ritual quality, the more shamblers that will appear.
BioSynth_SlavesOfHorax.PsychicRitualDef_.letterAICompleteText: The cultists' magic is drawing these lifeless corpses, and directing them to attack your colony.\n\nAs they exhaust their strange energy, they will begin to collapse within hours.
BioSynth_SlavesOfHorax.PsychicRitualDef_.letterAIArrivedText: They intend to use a psychic ritual to draw rotting shamblers to attack you.
